actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident2 contributed 80 (>30) in the last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity affordable (floor(wallet/punishment_cost)=465). I also broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.
